_comment: Documented attributes used to flag a step as written. Each flag cites the document that defines or supports it; flags are screening markers, not hazard or regulatory determinations.

Q3C1_solvent.label: ICH Q3C Class 1 solvent (1,2-dichloroethane, limit 5 ppm)

Q3C2_solvent.label: ICH Q3C Class 2 solvent in the step (e.g. DMF, DME, dichloromethane, THF, acetonitrile)
Q3C2_solvent.verified_against: ICH Q3C(R8) Table 2 lists acetonitrile 4.1 mg/day, dichloromethane 6.0, 1,2-dimethoxyethane 1.0, DMF 8.8

Pd_catalyst.label: Palladium catalyst: residual metal control (ICH Q3D Class 2B, oral PDE 100 ug/day)
Pd_catalyst.verified_against: ICH Q3D(R2) summary of PDE for palladium: oral 100 ug/day

BTZ_reagent.label: Coupling reagent derived from a hydroxybenzotriazole (HOAt) unit; the class is associated with thermal/explosive hazards
BTZ_reagent.verified_against: Wehrstedt et al. 2005 abstract: 1-hydroxybenzotriazoles show explosive properties; HATU itself is not named in the abstract

Prep_HPLC.label: Preparative HPLC used for purification in the disclosed example
Prep_HPLC.verified_against: WO2016/099393 Example Ib: preparative HPLC, 25-65 % MeCN in 50 mM NH4HCO3

Long_reaction.label: Reaction time of 2 days at room temperature in the disclosed example

Low_reported_yield.label: Reported isolated yield 16 % (8.2 mg from 40 mg of amine)

Lyophilisation_long_drying.label: Lyophilisation and drying at 80 C for 3 days to isolate the amorphous salt
Lyophilisation_long_drying.verified_against: WO2022/013153 amorphous HCl salt example (as extracted)
